info.name: Zendesk Account Account Settings Autocomplete API
Zendesk Get  Api V2 Autocomplete Tags

items.docs:
Returns an array of registered and recent tag names that start with the characters specified in the `name` query parameter. You must specify at least 2 characters.

#### Pagination

* Offset pagination only

See [Using Offset Pagination](/api-reference/introduction/pagination/#using-offset-pagination).


#### Allowed For

* Agents
